title: Coolpad Launches $150 Android Phone With Widescreen Design
excerpt: Coolpad has announced the Cool X Wide, a new $150 Android smartphone featuring a wider screen design reminiscent of folding phones.
body_html: Coolpad has introduced a new Android smartphone, the Cool X Wide, priced at $150. The device features a significantly wider screen compared to traditional slab phones, a design trend that is beginning to draw inspiration from widescreen folding devices and other contemporary market releases.
